title: mintUid
responsibility: Mints a fresh random unit uid that no existing unit holds.

inputs.name: mintUid.taken
inputs.description: The uids already in use: mintUid skips any candidate found in this Set and adds the returned uid to it in place. Uniqueness holds only against the Set passed in, so pass the same Set on every call; if every candidate that passes the uidPattern check is already in it, the call never returns.

outputs.name: mintUid
outputs.description: The new unit uid: the prefix u_ followed by ten characters, each a lowercase letter a-z or a digit 2-7. It is returned only after it passes the uidPattern check and is absent from taken; it is also added to taken at that point, so later calls sharing that Set never return it again.
